section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a study that examined the psychometric properties of a Romanian translation of the 10-item Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). The study involved two samples of university students from Romania, with N=453 in the first sample and N=109 in the second. Findings indicated a one-dimensional factor structure for BAS-2 scores in both women and men, though invariance across sex was not supported.
